verdict.rationale: Usage metering is a fair question for an invoicing and billing product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only invoicing, recurring invoices, time logging and billable expenses, which are adjacent features. Nothing shows a usage-event ingestion API, idempotency keys or backdated event support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream high-volume usage events — API calls, tokens, compute-seconds — into a metering pipeline with idempotent ingestion and backdating support
